root_cause.text: The btusb_work() function in drivers/bluetooth/btusb.c indexes a three-element lookup table using data->sco_num - 1 without validating that data->sco_num is within the table bounds, causing an out-of-bounds read when the number of active SCO links exceeds the table size.
root_cause.evidence: The commit description states: "The lookup currently indexes alts[] with data->sco_num - 1 without first constraining sco_num to the number of available table entries." The patch adds `sco_idx = min_t(unsigned int, data->sco_num - 1, ARRAY_SIZE(alts) - 1);` to clamp the index to the last valid entry.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The btusb_work() function in drivers/bluetooth/btusb.c indexes a three-element lookup table using data->sco_num - 1 without validating that data->sco_num is within the table bounds, causing an out-of-bounds read when the number of active SCO links exceeds the table size.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit description states: "The lookup currently indexes alts[] with data->sco_num - 1 without first constraining sco_num to the number of available table entries." The patch adds `sco_idx = min_t(unsigned int, data->sco_num - 1, ARRAY_SIZE(alts) - 1);` to clamp the index to the last valid entry.

candidates.rationale: This condition enables the vulnerable code path where the array indexing occurs.
This condition selects between the array-based assignment and a direct assignment, determining which branch uses the unvalidated sco_num.
Defines the three-element lookup table alts; its fixed size is the cause of the out-of-bounds read when sco_num exceeds 3.
Directly indexes alts using data->sco_num - 1 without bounds checking, causing an out-of-bounds read when data->sco_num is not in the range 1 to 3.
In the else branch, data->sco_num is used directly without validation; while not an array index, it reflects the overall missing validation of sco_num.

vuln_statements.explanation: Directly indexes the three-element array alts using data->sco_num - 1 without bounds checking, causing an out-of-bounds read when data->sco_num > 3.
Defines the three-element lookup table; its fixed size is the reason an out-of-bounds read occurs when sco_num exceeds 3.
Condition that enables the vulnerable code path where the array indexing occurs; if true, the unvalidated sco_num may be used as an index.
Condition that selects between the array-based assignment (vulnerable) and a direct assignment; it determines whether the out-of-bounds indexing is executed.
Else branch that assigns data->sco_num directly without validation; while not an array index, it reflects the overall missing validation of sco_num and is part of the vulnerable code flow.
